name: Core world
summary: Old Concordance world. Exports electronics and robots; imports raw materials and luxuries.

name: Agricultural world
summary: Farms and fisheries. Exports food; needs machinery and consumer goods.

name: Mining colony
summary: Digs ore and rare elements. Needs food, machinery and medicine.

name: Fuel refinery
summary: Skims helium-3 and deuterium from a giant planet. Exports fuel.

name: Ice harvester
summary: Mines water ice and volatiles. Exports water and chemicals.

name: Industrial world
summary: Factories and shipyards. Turns metals and chemicals into machinery and goods.

name: Frontier colony
summary: Young colony on the rim. Needs almost everything, pays well for it.

name: Research station
summary: Scientists and instruments. Buys biologics and electronics; small population.

name: Military base
summary: Garrison and naval yard. Buys weapons, fuel and food.

name: Robot world
summary: Fully automated world run by robots, with a handful of human overseers or none at all. Sells robots and electronics; wary of outsiders.

name: Free port
summary: Low-tariff trading station. Buys and sells a bit of everything.
